name: Hateful People
overview: Scripture acknowledges that there is a time to hate, as stated in Ecclesiastes 3:8, yet it also teaches believers to reject unlawful divisions and prejudices, as Peter learned in Acts 10:28 when God revealed that no person should be considered common or unclean. True Christian conduct calls for submission to God and resistance against the devil’s influence, which fosters hatred and division, as James 4:7 instructs. Thus, while hatred has its place in God's sovereign timing, believers are commanded to overcome hateful attitudes through obedience to God and love for all people.
